matches.notes: The studio intro doubles as the show's opening (welcoming the pundits) before turning specifically to Spurs v Newcastle at 01:54; the montage before it (00:58-01:35) is opening-weekend action, not this match. The post-match manager/player interviews run from 11:07 and blend straight into the studio's first analysis line around 12:26, so that boundary is approximate.
matches.handover: Steve Wilson was at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

matches.notes: The handover line at 16:57 appears truncated in the subtitles ("Your commentator..." with no name following). Studio analysis runs continuously from the Forest tactical breakdown through the Isak discussion and into the substitution-board issue from this game, ending when the studio moves on to Coventry v Hull at 32:52.

matches.handover: Guy Mowbray was at the CBS Arena.

matches.notes: No commentator is named at the handover; the studio simply gives a Bournemouth-Everton stat and commentary begins at 43:44. The post-match section runs continuously from the pitchside interviews (from 51:20) into a David Moyes press-conference clip, which the studio host briefly introduces at 52:41 before the clip plays; sustained studio analysis only begins at 53:08. Studio analysis ends at 57:04 when the host turns to Sunday's Match of the Day trailer.
matches.handover: Bournemouth had more wins against Everton than any other team they've faced in the Premier League, nine in total, two of which came when Ashley was at Everton.
Mark Scott was at Selhurst Park.
